missions.name: Sizing Anomalies

missions.query: Identify products with stock count below the reorder point across all locations.

missions.name: Supplier On-Time Rate Analysis
missions.query: Analyze supplier on-time rates to identify potential issues with delivery reliability.

missions.name: Geographic Sales Distribution
missions.query: Analyze sales events by country to identify trends and opportunities for geographic expansion.
